Problem_Description: Bracket weld seam cracking observed during incoming inspection
Solution_Text: Rework the weld seam per the original joint profile. Re-inspect before shipment.

Problem_Description: Cracks found in the weld seam of the mounting bracket at goods-in
Solution_Text: Segregate the affected lot. Rework the cracked seams and re-inspect each unit.

Problem_Description: Weld porosity detected on the bracket joint during inspection
Solution_Text: Grind out the porous region and re-weld to the original profile.

Problem_Description: Outer carton label misprinted on the shipment packaging
Solution_Text: Reprint the carton labels and re-apply them before dispatch.

Problem_Description: Carton labels unreadable on arrival at the dock
Solution_Text: Reprint and re-apply the labels; verify print quality before release.
